text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Wow... Gold City really is so pretty. I
was
mesmerized the whole time.

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text: But she's an awesome runner, too!

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text:
I honestly thought she was all looks at
first, but
she can run pretty well!

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text:
Man, this year's Classics sure have an
interesting
lineup! I can't wait for the
Derby!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Not bad, City! Off to a good start.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Soooo, why'm I just sittin' here watchin'?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Why'm I not out there too?!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Well, you do know, people are out there
praising
my running this time.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
It seems changing tours was the right
choice.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Some people were disappointed, but
because of
that, they're now paying
attention to my skill.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
If I keep running like this, I'll make it,
right?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
They'll see the real me, not just some
pretty doll!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
choice_data_list: この勢いで、ダービーを獲ろう！

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
That's right. If I become the Derby
champion, I'll
be considered the best of
my generation.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
choice_data_list: 残り少ないけど、徹底的に鍛えるぞ！
残り少ないけど、徹底的に鍛えるよ！
